author_training: Original DAG/sparsity/Adam/clip logic, task loss extended from cross entropy to MSE
adaptations: Fixed canonical 60/20/20 split, train-fitted shared encoders/scaler
Dirty training labels only, no ground-truth training cells
Separate clean validation selects epoch; the author runner builds val_loader from X_train
Each official operator uses original forward during training; dirty-train-only cached statistics at validation/test
KNN inference reference is dirty train, empirical CDF/frequency and log-domain clipping fixed from train
Frozen DAG representations are scored with the common main-table model rather than the author MLP head
Non-native regression extension changes only the head output to one real value and CE to MSE; dirty-train fitted target scaling; validation R2 selects epoch
Float64 regression arithmetic prevents gradient-norm overflow from repeated author polynomial operations under MSE; classification arithmetic remains original float32
